pages.text: Spawns items on the ground at a position.$(br2)$(1)count$() must be 1 to 64. The result is the UUID of the new item entity. This needs allowSpawning or an administrator as owner, otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised.

$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the items appear$(li)$(1)id$() STRING: the item ID, e.g. minecraft:bread$(li)$(1)count$() INTEGER: the number of items, 1 to 64$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the UUID of the item entity
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SPAWN_ITEM$(br)  PARAMETER position spot ;$(br)  PARAMETER id "minecraft:bread" ;$(br)  PARAMETER count 3 ;$(br)  RESULT result itemId$()
